title: Trading calendar
description: Validates reference/calendars/<calendar>_<year>.yaml: the weekdays of one year without a session. Sessions are Monday to Friday of the year minus these closures. Generated by `python -m engine.calendars`, never derived from prices (ADR-005).

calendar.description: XWAR: the MIC of the Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW). NBP: the publication days of the nbp source (table A).

year.description: The calendar year the file covers.

recorded_date.description: When this year's content was last written, ISO date, so reference data is point in time (ADR-004).

closures.description: Weekdays of the year without a session, ascending by date.

date.description: A weekday with no session, ISO date, quoted so YAML keeps it a string.

name.description: Why: the holiday name in English, or `Ad hoc closure`.
